rca_of_issue: Unverified native acceptance is an environment/evidence gap, not a confirmed logic failure in this run: web preview is MOCKED by configuration, and native Android compile/device execution was not performed here. Additionally, JS bridge-side evidence validation appears narrower than native contract checks, so malformed records with invalid `result` may rely on upstream filtering instead of being rejected at boundary.
